escena: SCENE (recording Efeonce's own podcast, a clean premium conversation set with warm neutral walls, oak and grey acoustic felt, late afternoon): 85mm lens at f/2.2 from behind a studio camera, both people sharp. Julio sits on the LEFT in a charcoal knit sweater, leaning back slightly, his hand at his chin, listening; Nexa sits on the RIGHT in a cream blouse, leaning in, one open hand mid-gesture, caught at the exact moment she makes her point. They are LOOKING AT EACH OTHER: his head is turned in three-quarter toward the right edge and his eyes land on her face; her head is turned in three-quarter toward the left edge and her eyes land on his face; their eye lines meet across the small oak table between them. Neither looks at the camera. Each has a broadcast microphone on a black boom arm in front of the mouth, off to the side so the face stays visible, and a ceramic mug on the table. A single large window at the right side is the key light: soft but directional, raking across both faces, with a warm-neutral fill; practical lamps are OFF. The only bright azure blue is a small object on the shelf behind them, out of focus; no blue panels on the walls. Everything unbranded; no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the out-of-focus black body of the studio camera in the foreground, spanning the full width of the bottom of the frame
lecho.tono: DARK near black, matte, no highlights
